Use the expectation formula: E(X) = 0(0.3) + 1(p) + 2(r) + 3(0.15) = 1.1, which simplifies to p + 2r = 0.65.
Subtract the two equations to find r: (p + 2r) - (p + r) = 0.65 - 0.55, giving r = 0.10 and p = 0.45.
walkthrough:
Form the total probability equation:
$$\sum_{x=0}^3 \mathrm{P}(X = x) = 1$$
$$0.3 + p + r + 0.15 = 1 \implies p + r = 0.55$$

Form the expectation equation using $\mathrm{E}(X) = 1.1$:
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = \sum x \mathrm{P}(X = x) = 0(0.3) + 1(p) + 2(r) + 3(0.15) = 1.1$$
$$p + 2r + 0.45 = 1.1 \implies p + 2r = 0.65$$

Solve the simultaneous linear equations:
$$(p + 2r) - (p + r) = 0.65 - 0.55 \implies r = 0.10$$
$$p = 0.55 - 0.10 = 0.45$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Set up the sum of probabilities equation:
The sum of all probabilities in a discrete probability distribution must equal 1:
$$\mathrm{P}(X = 0) + \mathrm{P}(X = 1) + \mathrm{P}(X = 2) + \mathrm{P}(X = 3) = 1$$
$$0.3 + p + r + 0.15 = 1$$
$$p + r + 0.45 = 1$$
$$p + r = 0.55 \quad \text{--- (Equation 1)}$$

Step 2: Set up the expectation equation:
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = \sum x \mathrm{P}(X = x)$$
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = (0)(0.3) + (1)(p) + (2)(r) + (3)(0.15)$$
$$\mathrm{E}(X) = p + 2r + 0.45$$
We are given $\mathrm{E}(X) = 1.1$:
$$p + 2r + 0.45 = 1.1$$
$$p + 2r = 0.65 \quad \text{--- (Equation 2)}$$

Step 3: Solve the simultaneous equations:
Subtract Equation 1 from Equation 2:
$$(p + 2r) - (p + r) = 0.65 - 0.55$$
$$r = 0.10$$
Substitute $r = 0.10$ back into Equation 1:
$$p + 0.10 = 0.55$$
$$p = 0.45$$
